Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks close higher as tech rebound puts Nvidia in focus
Markets.summary: US stocks closed higher, driven by a rebound in technology and semiconductor shares ahead of Nvidia's upcoming earnings report. Lower oil prices and Treasury yields also provided relief, even as investors weighed economic concerns, consumer confidence, and upcoming inflation data.

Markets.title: Crude oil prices slide 4% as markets look past Iran sanctions
Markets.summary: Crude oil prices fell about 4% to their lowest levels since mid-August after the U.S. announced milder sanctions on Iran than traders expected. Despite this drop, ongoing shipping risks and potential supply disruptions in Russia and Kazakhstan continue to concern the market.

Markets.title: Anthropic expected to tell investors it sees over $30 trillion in potential revenue, WSJ reports
Markets.summary: Anthropic plans to tell investors that its total addressable market exceeds $30 trillion in preparation for an upcoming IPO. The company is using this projection to justify massive infrastructure spending and support its 2028 revenue target of $200 billion.

Markets.title: Japanese bond funds see record inflows as rising yields attract global investors
Markets.summary: Foreign investors, particularly from Europe, are pouring record amounts of capital into Japanese government bonds. This surge is driven by rising yields that have made the bonds increasingly attractive to global markets.

Markets.title: Lumino Industries raises Rs 207 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on August 27
Markets.summary: Lumino Industries raised Rs 206.99 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 700 crore initial public offering. The public subscription period for the share sale, priced between Rs 78 and Rs 82 per share, runs from August 27 to August 31, 2026.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty reversed morning losses to close higher on Tuesday amid sharp volatility. Healthcare and financial stocks led the gains, while the broader market breadth remained mixed and cautious.

Geo-Political.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on American goods, including steel, furniture, tuna, and makeup. This move marks the latest escalation in the ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada.

Geo-Political.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
Geo-Political.summary: China criticized new United States sanctions targeting Iran and its trading partners as illegal. The United States threatened to isolate countries that continue doing business with Tehran, which is a major oil supplier to Beijing.

Geo-Political.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
Geo-Political.summary: US media report that the CIA director traveled to Moscow for unannounced discussions. Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft flew from the United States to Russia via Latvia on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
Geo-Political.summary: Global law enforcement launched a crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks. This operation included the arrest of 39 individuals in South Africa for involvement in romance and investment scams.

Geo-Political.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
Geo-Political.summary: A recent study found that at least 25 percent of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 suffered from a degenerative brain disease. Researchers note that the actual rate of the disease among these deceased players is likely much higher.

Geo-Political.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
Geo-Political.summary: A tornado struck the south-western French village of Pomas, damaging hundreds of homes. Fifteen people were hospitalized with injuries following the severe weather.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An entrepreneur discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment demonstrated a shift in organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to artificial intelligence optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal offers BIS exemptions to high-tech chipmakers, AI firms to boost ‘Make in India’
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has granted Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) exemptions to semiconductor and AI companies. This policy change addresses concerns raised by Japanese firms and aims to accelerate advanced technology operations in India.

Data & Insights.title: India plans 100 new ships to cut $75 billion foreign freight bill
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to add 100 new ships to reduce its $75 billion foreign freight bill. This expansion addresses a current disadvantage where operating under the Indian flag is 16-20% more expensive than operating under foreign flags.

Data & Insights.title: India’s macro strength cushions global shocks as war, tariffs cloud outlook: RBI
Data & Insights.summary: According to the Reserve Bank of India's August bulletin, the country's strong macroeconomic foundation is protecting it from global economic shocks, geopolitical conflicts, and tariff uncertainties. High-frequency indicators show that economic momentum remains solid, driven by sustained activity in both the manufacturing and services sectors.

Data & Insights.title: EMT: India secures top rank again in July among EM peers as stock market posts gains
Data & Insights.summary: India secured the top rank in Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for July due to resilient economic performance and strong stock market inflows. The country maintained this leading position for the third consecutive month despite rising inflationary pressures.

Data & Insights.title: India leads South Asia’s growth, but China+1 gains remain uncertain: World Bank economist
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank economist Franziska Ohnsorge states that India is leading South Asia's economic growth, though its potential gains from the China+1 strategy have not yet materialized. She also suggests that artificial intelligence represents a significantly larger potential driver for the country's future growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent plans to use the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund expanded buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This strategy, reported by CNBC, was cited by two senior officials.

India.title: Weather Highlights: Heavy Rain In Delhi, Waterlogging, Traffic Jams In Many Areas
India.summary: Heavy rain and thunderstorms hit Delhi-NCR, prompting an IMD weather alert for the region. The downpour caused widespread waterlogging and traffic jams across multiple areas.

India.title: PM Modi Chairs PRAGATI Meet, Pushes AI Use In Farming And Cyber Fraud Fight
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi chaired a PRAGATI meeting where he stressed that infrastructure delays harm citizens, businesses, and the economy beyond just increasing costs. He also pushed for the increased use of artificial intelligence in agriculture and the fight against cyber fraud.

India.title: Madhya Pradesh Forest Department To Launch Snake-Catcher App Soon
India.summary: The Madhya Pradesh Forest Department is launching a digital platform called SHIVAA. The app will connect citizens with trained snake rescuers and guide snakebite victims to treatment.

India.title: Man Detained For Throwing Stones At Vande Bharat. UP Governor Was On Board
India.summary: A man was detained for throwing stones at a Vande Bharat train in Uttar Pradesh. UP Governor Anandiben Patel was on board the train at the time of the incident.

India.title: Meghalaya To Restore Vandalised Netaji, Vivekananda Statues In Shillong
India.summary: The Meghalaya government will restore statues of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and Swami Vivekananda that were vandalized during a Khasi Students Union rally in Shillong. The statues were damaged on August 19.

India.title: "This Country Not A Dharamshala": Amit Shah Unveils 2047 Security Blueprint
India.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah stated that a developed India requires stronger internal security because the nation is not a "dharamshala" (shelter house). He unveiled a 2047 security blueprint, linking national security directly to the country's economic and social progress.

General.title: Dolly Parton: The life of an iconic country singer
General.summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80. Her team announced the news on social media.

General.title: Father's house rammed before son died in A66 crash
General.summary: A father's house was significantly damaged after being rammed, with its windows smashed. The incident preceded a crash on the A66 that resulted in the death of his son, Cole Worthy.

General.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports

General.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
General.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on American goods, including steel, furniture, fresh tuna, and makeup. This move marks the latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada.

General.title: Man dies in crash after police pursuit
General.summary: A man died in a car crash following a police pursuit. Two women were also injured, with one remaining hospitalized in critical condition.

General.title: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
General.summary: President Trump stated that all mines have been cleared from the Strait of Hormuz. Iran had previously closed the vital waterway since the conflict began, which caused wild fluctuations in global oil prices.
